programme.title: Angler's Workshop | Building a Bladed Jig Rod
programme.desc: Jim reviews how to build your own bladed jig rod.

programme.title: Hook 'n Look — Skinny-Water Smallmouths
programme.desc: Smallmouth bass, particularly those that are positioned shallow, are susceptible to a topwater lure. Yet, anglers need to realize as conditions change, so should your lure choice.

programme.title: FishON | Summer Jigging
programme.desc: Hot summer Jigging rap walleye on Ivanhoe Lake with our local anglers and big bags of walleye.

programme.title: FishON | Smallmouth Bass
programme.desc: Smallmouth Bass in quantities in this episode. A Thanksgiving tradition.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - Epic Five Day Fishing Charter on the Top One 80, Part Three
programme.desc: Stoked On Fishing jumps on board the Top Gun 80 out of San Diego, California, for Stan Vanderburg's annual five-day Rod & Reel Radio charter. We go offshore and have an absolute blast. We finish the trip in style in part three, catching some more bluefin tuna and giant yellowtail.

programme.title: Catching Bass | Post Spawn Bass
programme.desc: Dustin explains the lures and locations to best catch post-spawn bass.

programme.title: FishON! | "Trophy Walleye Adventure on Pierre Lake"
programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat Fishing on the Ranger 85 (Part 3)
programme.desc: Join the Stoked on Fishing crew as they travel to incredible fishing destinations, chase down a wide variety of species, and share the stories of the people and places behind each catch. Whether it’s offshore, inshore, freshwater, or somewhere off the beaten path, every episode brings you along for the adventure — with real anglers, real conditions, and no scripted nonsense.

programme.title: Wired2Fish | Baits and Gear For the Biggest Catch
programme.desc: The team from Wired2Fish delivers the goods on how to catch the biggest fish—wherever or whenever you're casting lines.

programme.title: Angler's Workshop | Making Lure Molds & Pouring soft plastics
programme.desc: Jim visits Cast Industries to see how lure molds are made. Then he visits Lure Parts Online to show you how to pour your own soft plastic baits.

programme.title: Operation Fishing Freedom - Navy Veteran Keith Lorensen
programme.desc: Keith Lorensen is no stranger to water, he spent many years at sea during his service in the U.S. Navy. Back in October of 2000, Keith was injured during a terrorist attack on the historic USS Cole.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | A Fisherman's Paradise: Stoked on Puerto Rico, Part Three
programme.desc: Join Stoked On Fishing as we embark on a thrilling 6-day fishing expedition to the enchanted Island of Puerto Rico. Nestled along the west coast, we'll be based in the charming fishing town of La Pargueta and fishing along the west coast locations of Cabo Rojo and Rincon. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure filled with wide-open offshore and inshore fishing. Stoked On Puerto Rico

programme.title: Angling Buzz - All About Swimbaits
programme.desc: This episode is all about Swimbaits, perhaps the most versatile tool in the tackle box for catching just about everything that swims.

programme.title: Hank Parker Fishing
programme.desc: Fishing legend Hank Parker take viewers to the most secluded locations for the biggest fish.

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors
programme.desc: We're heading to Lake Gogebic this week to find some GIANT Perch and walleye! Joined by Chris Fish and Justin Soffa, this will surely be a fishing smackdown!

programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.title: FishON! | Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Heavy hearts find comfort in cherished memories as the Local Knowledge crew mourns the loss of one of the greatest members of the fishing industry. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Join Rush and his good friend Anthony Solmo for an epic day of fishing in the stunning waters of Key West, Florida! Leaving the Odyssea at the dock, they hop on a bay boat outfitted with a trolling motor for the ultimate inshore adventure. Gliding quietly through the shallows, they target a variety of species—including hard-pulling Tarpon and explosive topwater Jacks—leaving Rush thinking, “A guy could get used to this kind of fishing!”

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush and Ali head to La Paz Mexico to fish with longtime friends and soak up some Baja living in the City of Peace. In part one of this two part series, the guys fish offshore targeting striped marlin and dorado with a few surprises.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Marine veteran Eddie Jaramillo speaks about his life of - continuing service while he and host Jay Garstecki get tattoos from - the premiere tattoo artist in the country.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Motorcycle junkie and Army veteran Dave Allen recounts the terrifying prospect of facing chemical warfare during Operation Desert Storm with host Jay Garstecki and special guest Paul Sr. from American Choppers.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Shot through the neck on Fort Hood in Texas, Green Beret John Arroyo recounts coming face to face with his attacker and Jesus blinding his would be killer.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Ginger Gilbert-Ravella honors the memory her husband…American hero Troy Gilbert.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: With the fall of the Soviet Union, wildlife populations in Tajikistan were devastated, bringing some of their unique mountain species to the brink of extinction. With the help of funds generated through hunting, vast areas are now being conserved and protected. Dan Cabela explores this conservation success.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Human encroachment and pressure from poaching are the greatest threats to wildlife in Africa. Dan Cabela has traveled to Tanzania to see how Robin Hurt safaris manages two large conservation areas in the face of these daily challenges.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: With human populations scattered through the landscape, human-wildlife conflict is a common occurrence in Borneo. Dan Cabela travels to the area to participate in an ambitious elephant collaring project, hoping to better understand how people and elephants can live harmoniously.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: A remnant of the last Ice Age, the musk ox is almost mythical in appearance. For the people who share the Barren Ground region of Canada with them, they are an integral part of their culture. Show host, Dan Cabela, participates in a scientific sampling project to monitor the - population's health, and get first-hand experience of the relationship between local people and this arctic icon.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: They say you come to New Zealand as a stranger, but leave as family. In this episode of DIRT, the crew goes full circle—meeting Muttonbird chefs Emma and George on the South Island before hopping up to Raglan and working their way back down. Water skiing next to snow-capped mountains, cooking in hot springs the Māori way, and stargazing at Wairarapa Dark Sky Reserve are all on the itinerary. But it’s the final “Feed” done Kiwi-style that makes one thing clear—in this unique and stunning land, nobody’s a stranger for long.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2012, en Cúcuta, Johana Rincón fue hallada muerta en su casa con señales de tortura. Tras huir a Venezuela y esconderse durante varios días, fue capturado por la Policía al regresar a Colombia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El asesinato del niño Luis Santiago en Chía (Cundinamarca).

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En una vereda de Cimitarra, Santander, Pedro Suta se obsesiona con Irene, esposa de su jefe Arcilio. Tras ser rechazado, la asesina junto a su hijo menor, decapitándola y desmembrando al niño. Ese día, Arcilio estaba de viaje con otro hijo por un tratamiento médico. Al descubrirse las desapariciones, la comunidad se alerta e inicia una intensa búsqueda para dar con el responsable del doble homicidio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Katiris Milena Guzmán, estudiante de estilismo de 21 años, fue hallada muerta en un parque de Riohacha, La Guajira. El caso quedó archivado por falta de pruebas. En 2018, su expareja, Ismael Toncel, fue capturado tras intentar agredir a otra mujer, lo que reabrió el caso. En 2019, fue condenado a 22 años de prisión por el homicidio y agresión sexual contra Katiris.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
